definitionZh: 文本装饰CSS的短手属性设置了文本上装饰线的外观. 它是文本装饰线,文本装饰色,文本装饰风格的简称,也是较新的文本装饰层层属性.
sourceDefinition: The text-decoration CSS shorthand property sets the appearance of decorative lines on text. It is a shorthand for text-decoration-line, text-decoration-color, text-decoration-style, and the newer text-decoration-thickness property.
